summary: Trekor Metals Limited, a mining company, acquires and develops mineral properties. It explores for copper, molybdenum, gold, niobium, and silver deposits. The company's principal assets consist of 100% owned the Gibraltar mine located in south-central British Columbia; and the Florence Copper project in Arizona. The company was formerly known as Taseko Mines Limited and changed its name Trekor Metals Limited in June 2026. Trekor Metals Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
